sources.title: MaleCNS v1.0 annotation and connectome data
sources.paper: Berg et al. (2026), Sexual dimorphism in the complete Drosophila male central nervous system connectome
sources.credit: Berg et al. 2026; MaleCNS project, FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), University of Cambridge, MRC LMB, Google Research; male-cns:v1.0; original data link; CC BY 4.0 link; describe selection and aggregation.
sources.boundary: Dataset license is not a license for neuPrint software, site source code, or third-party FlyWire/hemibrain transformed assets. Do not mix specimens or versions.

sources.title: Rayshubskiy et al. steering electrophysiology
sources.paper: Rayshubskiy et al. (2025), Neural circuit mechanisms for steering control in walking Drosophila, Version of Record
sources.credit: Rayshubskiy, Holtz, Wilson and colleagues; dataset DOI and v1.2; paper DOI; describe own spike detection and selection. CC0 does not impose attribution, but scholarly credit is retained.
sources.boundary: Dataset license and code license are separate. DNa code-derived implementation must retain Wilson Lab MIT notice. Keep 23 MAT, 33 channels and biological specimens distinct.

sources.title: Huang, Luo et al. voltage traces
sources.credit: Huang, Luo et al. 2024; data creators Huang and Schnitzer; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10998457; cite changes and CC BY 4.0.
sources.boundary: Use completed 96-record tables, not baseline 76-record table. Preserve duplicate/numeric-source cautions from discrepancy-resolution analysis.

sources.title: McCurdy et al. reversal-learning Source Data
sources.credit: McCurdy, Sareen, Davoudian and Nitabach (2021), paper DOI; Source Data workbook/sheet/cell; describe recomputed windows and contrasts.
sources.boundary: Author is McCurdy et al., not Zhao et al. Preserve corrected 19-value window and source inconsistencies; this check does not license unrelated publisher assets.

sources.title: Mussells Pires et al. navigation data
sources.credit: Mussells Pires et al. 2024; data DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10145317; CC BY 4.0; identify selected H5 records and independent phase/behavior calculations.
sources.boundary: Pires code archive 10.5281/zenodo.10232698 v1.0.0 also explicitly CC BY 4.0; translated/adapted upstream code must not be labelled solely MIT. EPG and FC2 are separate fly groups.

sources.title: Agrawal et al. proprioception physiology and behavior
sources.credit: Agrawal et al. 2020; paper and dataset DOI; original Fig.3/Fig.6 or 13Balpha records; describe new summary statistic.
sources.boundary: Passive female T1 physiology and decapitated left foreleg interventions do not identify six right T2 MaleCNS candidates.

sources.title: Durrieu et al. affordance experiments and silencing screen
sources.credit: Durrieu et al. 2026 preprint version 2; specific Dataverse DOI and selected version; changes to observation windows/trajectory summaries.
sources.boundary: Data CC0 does not transfer to article PDF (local record says CC BY-NC 4.0). No article or upstream code copying is proposed. Screen records may use an older pinned version; preserve source manifest.

sources.title: Rozenfeld and Parnas activity/archive data
sources.credit: Rozenfeld and Parnas 2024 paper; Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13764295; describe column-level reductions, nonpaired contrasts and archive/paper year difference.
sources.boundary: The dataset archive includes upstream code. Copying/translation of it needs CC BY notices; raw code is not included in the allowlist.

sources.title: Dan et al. navigation model
sources.credit: Dan et al. 2024; pinned commit; independent Python implementation and simulation conditions. Preserve Hermundstad Lab full MIT text when distributing adapted substantial code.
sources.boundary: Simulation output is not biological recording. Zenodo v1.0 archive11062515 lists CC BY 4.0; use the exact pinned GitHub code license instead of conflating archive records.

sources.title: Dan et al. behavioral and calcium imaging data v1
sources.credit: Dan et al. 2024; exact data DOI v1; changes; source noncommercial condition.
sources.boundary: Do not relabel upstream fragments/derived copied numeric arrays CC BY 4.0. This is a conservative packaging recommendation, not a legal conclusion that every independent computed fact inherits NC.

sources.title: Isakov and Buchanan locomotion recovery data
sources.credit: Isakov et al.; data DOI; local processing and study-selection boundary; noncommercial condition.
sources.boundary: Exclude thresholded_frames and numerical-table reuse from default CC BY allowlist. Own factual prose summary with primary citation can remain; no inference that pure facts are copyrighted is made.

sources.title: Chen et al. synchronized GLM input ZIPs
sources.credit: Chen et al. 2023; exact pinned repo input path; Apache notice for any code copy; local synchronization and ROI treatment.
sources.boundary: Do not silently MIT-license copied Apache source. If included under repository Apache grant, retain Apache license and any applicable notices/changes; numeric-table default allowlist omits this family pending parent scope decision.

sources.title: Wilson Lab secondary analysis code
sources.credit: Copyright (c) 2025 Wilson Lab; retained full notice in licenses/Wilson-Lab-MIT.txt

sources.title: Azevedo et al. (2024), motor system muscle atlas
sources.use: Literature-backed anatomical mappings, with original curation; no article PDF or figure copy distributed. Different specimens remain separate.

sources.title: Motor function references

citations.title: McKellar et al. 2020 proboscis motor system

sources.use: Independent factual summaries, not copied paper text or figures; unresolved mappings retained.

sources.title: Type-matched activity and intervention literature
sources.use: Type-level bridge only; reconstructed MaleCNS cells are not the measured physiological specimens.
